I removed all 20 `# TODO(...)` comment lines under `shop/` and changed nothing else. The tests pass: `python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -t .` ran 6 tests, OK.

- **What was removed:** each file in `shop/carriers/` had one TODO line, always line 1. The 20 files are tundra, juniper, fjord, prairie, quartz, harbor, ember, gale, acme, borealis, lumen, cedar, nimbus, kestrel, summit, iris, maple, ridge, onyx and delta.
- **Checks:** a search for `# TODO(` lines under `shop/` now finds nothing. `git diff` shows only those 20 deleted lines, with nothing added.
- **Nothing skipped:** every match was a comment on its own line, so no line of code or text inside a string was touched.

The search only matched the exact form `# TODO(`, so a variant like `#TODO(` would not have been caught.
